Meet the Kitty

One small cat, fully geared for adventure

Every detail of the Wizard Kitty is part of the kit — from the moon on his hat to the potions rattling on his belt.

The Star Hat

A tall blue wizard hat scattered with golden stars and a crescent moon — with two orange ears poking straight through the brim. A wizard never hides his ears.

The Crystal Staff

A rune-carved wooden staff crowned with a glowing purple crystal orb. It hums when treasure — or tuna — is near.

The Robe & Cape

A deep-blue robe with gold trim and a lightning sigil on the chest, worn under a star-dusted cape. Dramatic billowing included at no extra cost.

The Potion Belt

Purple and teal potion bottles, a rolled-up scroll, lucky charms and a very serious adventurer's pouch. He is always one sip away from a plan.

The Spellbook

Five rules of the tiny wizard

Copied paw-by-paw from the Wizard Kitty's own spellbook. Do not lick the pages.

I.

Curiosity first

Every closed door is a spell waiting to be opened.

II.

Small is a strategy

Fit through the gap the dragon can't.

III.

Charge the crystal

Rest is part of the ritual. Naps are sacred.

IV.

Share the potions

Magic tastes better with friends around the fire.

V.

Land on your feet

Every failed spell is just a rehearsal.

How to bring the Wizard Kitty along

Scroll the PFP collection above and choose the face that fits — laughing, cool, sleepy, or full smirk.

STEP 2

STEP 3

Cast responsibly

Set it as your avatar and carry the tiny wizard with you. Side effects include confidence and spontaneous sparkles.
